🦃 THANKSGIVING EVENT IS HERE! 🦃

The turkeys are on the loose!
Get ready for an all-out Thanksgiving showdown! Capture the turkey and bring it back to your base before enemies steal yours!
Defend your turkey, raid enemy territory, and help your team claim victory!
Gobble up the competition! Who will rule Thanksgiving?

Welcome to SHOWDOWN, the anime-style first person shooter game on Roblox! Challenge other players in fast-paced Duels, Sniper battles, and Quick Play matches where guns, blades, and jutsu decide the winner.
The Showdown Pass is Live! Check out the new pass and get exclusive weapon!
🔫 Play matches in Duels, Sniper, or Quick Play!
📋 Complete daily tasks to earn Coins!
🪙 Spend Coins to unlock new weapons and jutsu!
☀️ Become invincible under the sun!

🎮 Available on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
👍 Like & Favorite to unlock new jutsu and weapons!
💬 Join our Discord for codes, sneak peeks & events!
